blocks.text: International beauty queens and celebrities under ALV Talent Circuit brought glamour and creativity to a star-studded ball celebrating Halloween through their costumes depicting fictional characters and beings. Titleholders from ALV Pageant Circle joined talents under esteemed queenmaker and talent manager Arnold Vegafria at “Shake, Rattle & Ball: Lucid” by socialite Tim Yap held at the grand ballroom of Manila Marriott Hotel in Pasay City on the actual night of Halloween, Oct. 31.
